description.value: A forested peninsula campground on McLeod Lake, 130 km north of Prince George via paved Highway 97, offering a sheltered sandy beach, celebrated lake sunsets, and full family amenities including playground and volleyball.

address.value: Highway 97, 130 km north of Prince George, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Whiskers Point Park is an active frontcountry campground (59 sites per OSM, seasonal May–Sept) on McLeod Lake, 130 km north of Prince George on Hwy 97. The 'Book camping' button and the /reservations/frontcountry-camping/ subpage confirm reservations are accepted. No mention of showers, laundry, hiker/biker-specific sites, device charging, bike tools, or most other amenities; the site explicitly states the sani-station has been removed.
concerns: No address or phone number in OSM record; park page does not list a direct campground phone number.
Seasonal operation only (May 15 – Sept. 8, weather permitting per OSM note); directory entry should reflect this.
Sani-station has been removed from this park; website directs users to Crooked River and Carp Lake parks instead.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate BC Parks frontcountry campground on a major northern BC touring route (Hwy 97 north of Prince George) with 59 sites and online reservations; a clear benefit to touring cyclists travelling this corridor.

wow_evidence: sheltered sandy beach, celebrated lake sunsets
